cases.title: Discard password on Never For This Site selection
cases.description: Preconditions: Save password dialog box is displayed for a site. Action: Select Never For This Site. Expected Behavior: The browser discards the password.

cases.title: Present multiple saved choices for a website
cases.description: Preconditions: Multiple usernames and passwords for a website are saved. Action: Navigate to the website login page later. Expected Behavior: Those same choices are available to be presented.

cases.title: Update password manager when password is changed
cases.description: Preconditions: A username and password for a website are saved and the password is subsequently changed. Action: Submit the changed password on the website. Expected Behavior: The password manager picks up the new password.

cases.title: Disable password manager in preferences panel
cases.description: Preconditions: Password manager is disabled from the preferences panel. Action: Navigate to login sites and attempt to save or autofill credentials. Expected Behavior: The browser no longer asks to save passwords and no longer gets prefilled info on sites.

cases.title: View saved credentials in password manager through preferences
cases.description: Preconditions: A username and password are saved in the password manager. Action: Open the password manager through preferences. Expected Behavior: This information is viewable in the password manager.

cases.title: Remove specific username and password for a given site
cases.description: Preconditions: A username and password for a given site are saved and listed in the password manager. Action: Remove the username and password for that given site. Expected Behavior: It no longer autofills on that site nor is it listed in the password manager.

cases.title: Remove all username and password information
cases.description: Preconditions: Multiple username and password information entries are saved. Action: Remove all username and password information. Expected Behavior: It no longer autofills nor is anything listed in the password manager.

opinions.feedback: All cases are correctly grounded in their respective requirements, with clear preconditions, actionable steps, and verifiable expected behaviors. No blockers found.
